mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%) signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains at or below 0.1% for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 20d returns are negative in >60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment (UNRATE > 9.0%) signals weak labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 9.0%, 20d forward returns are positive in >60% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) reflects robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS (both > 0.5% MoM for 2 consecutive months) fails to predict positive 20d returns in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) during post-recession recovery periods (GDP growth > 0.5% QoQ) indicates strengthening supply-side activity, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In the post-recession recovery regime (GDP growth > 0.5% QoQ and unemployment falling), INDPRO growth fails to predict positive 60d returns (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: High year-over-year inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) erodes corporate margins and consumer purchasing power, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, 20d forward returns are positive in >60% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Strong monthly payroll growth (PAYEMS > 0.5% MoM) indicates a tightening labor market and rising economic activity, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth (MoM) > 0.5% fails to predict positive 5d returns in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent acceleration in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 1.0% QoQ) and housing starts (HOUST > 0.5% MoM) signals a broad-based economic upswing, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint growth in GDPC1 (QoQ > 1.0%) and HOUST (MoM > 0.5%) fails to predict positive 20d returns in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.5% in 3 months) increase borrowing costs and reduce liquidity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising >0.5% in 3 months), 60d forward returns are positive in >60% of cases.
